summary: Phase E item 2 (Marketplace Memberships) fully tested across shared backend, web (RadioLife overlay) and mobile (Expo). 14/14 backend pytest cases pass covering merchant CRUD (list w/ member_count, create/update/delete, bad_interval 400), consumer flows (business_memberships w/ mine+benefits, subscribe already_member + new-plan checkout_url, mine, cancel), and the claim engine (option_required, invalid option, period decrement + limit_reached). Web merchant + shop memberships UIs, mem-mine, subscribe button, option chips, claim buttons, and business-detail entry link all present. Mobile merchant + shop memberships screens, mem-mine, subscribe/claim, business-detail and merchant-dashboard entry links all present. Only bug found: web MerchantDashRadioLife is missing the merchant-open-memberships entry link (parity gap — mobile has it).

ui_bugs.issue: Missing 'Memberships' entry-link button on merchant dashboard. All other entries (Menu, Services, Products, Gift Cards, Plan) are present but merchant-open-memberships is not rendered. Users can only reach /shop/merchant/memberships by typing the URL. Reference: /app/frontend/src/design_radiolife/screens/MerchantDashRadioLife.jsx (grid around lines 86-95)

issues: Action row (Menu Builder / Services / Products / Gift Cards / Memberships / Plan) overflows horizontally with icons overlapping labels at 390px width. Pre-existing pattern, not introduced by memberships; flagged for future polish.

parity_issues.issue: merchant-open-memberships testID exists on mobile (/app/mobile/app/merchant/dashboard.tsx:122) but is not rendered on web MerchantDashRadioLife
parity_issues.expected: Web merchant dashboard should include a Memberships tile like mobile does
parity_issues.actual: Web only shows Menu, Services, Products, Gift Cards, Plan

action_items: Add merchant-open-memberships tile to /app/frontend/src/design_radiolife/screens/MerchantDashRadioLife.jsx (navigate('/shop/merchant/memberships')) to match mobile parity
critical_code_review_comments: subscribe endpoint hardcodes currency='usd'; consider deriving from business/market for internationalization
cancel_membership silently swallows Stripe exceptions (except: pass) — consider logging so ops can spot orphaned subscriptions

membership_claims.count_documents is called on every /businesses/{id}/memberships and /memberships/mine per benefit — fine at current scale but could hit N+1 with many entitlements; consider aggregate group_by(benefit_id) in future
test_credentials: demo@bigfm.dubai via POST /api/auth/demo (web cookie) / demo-login-btn (mobile bearer). Demo owns biz_8484f6f985d5 and is active member of the seeded Coffee Club plan.
seed_data_creation: Test cases create/delete throwaway TEST_* plans; no persistent seed added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend membership CRUD + claim engine are solid. Only fix required is adding merchant-open-memberships tile on web merchant dashboard. After that, re-run playwright to confirm the link renders and navigates to /shop/merchant/memberships. Note: daily 'Free coffee' benefit will already be at limit_reached in most test runs (that is correct behaviour, not a bug).
rca of the issue: The web MerchantDashRadioLife.jsx grid of merchant tiles was not updated when memberships was added in Phase E item 2; mobile dashboard.tsx was updated. Fix: add a Crown-icon button navigating to /shop/merchant/memberships with data-testid='merchant-open-memberships' in the same grid block that renders merchant-open-giftcards.
